items.headline: Mark Keenum thrilled about Mississippi State's competitiveness
items.description: MS State president Mark Keenum joins The Paul Finebaum Show to share his excitement surrounding the Bulldogs' progress ahead of the program's test against Alabama.

items.headline: Tebow says MS State's Taylor is great role model, previews UF vs. Mizzou
items.description: Tim Tebow joins The Paul Finebaum Show and explains why Kamario Taylor stands for all the great things about college sports before diving into the matchup between the No. 8 Gators and No. 25 Tigers.

items.headline: Zac Selmon says camaraderie bleeds from Bulldogs into the community
items.description: Mississippi State athletics director Selmon joins The Paul Finebaum Show to discuss how the Bulldogs' programs have been able to do great things with consistency and a shared vision.

items.headline: Jeff Lebby details No. 16 Mississippi State's success this season
items.description: Lebby joins The Paul Finebaum Show and explains what has led to the 4-0 start for the Bulldogs as they are set to host No. 7 Alabama.

items.headline: Alabama prepares for MS State's cowbells, defensive challenge
items.description: Yea Alabama's Emily Grace McWhorter joins SEC This Morning to discuss No. 7 Alabama's focus on defensive discipline and how the Tide is preparing for the cowbell-heavy atmosphere at No. 16 MS State.

items.headline: Top 25 betting lines: Ohio State, Florida, Alabama all road favorites this week against ranked foes
items.description: This week's odds and FPI predictions for Missouri-Florida, Iowa-Ohio State, Mississippi State-Alabama and every top 25 matchup.
